treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Lebanon and the Czech Republic for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (1997)
eif_quote: Libanon | 24.1.2000 | 30/2000 Sb.m.s. (Czech MoF list, via treaty map)
source_title: Lebanon MoF: Lebanon-Czech Republic DTC, English text (scanned signed copy; English prevails)

rates.quote: However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident, and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.
Interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

b) 10 per cent of the gross amount of royalties paid for the use of, or the right to use, any copyright of literary, artistic or scientific work, including cinematograph films and films or tapes for radio or television broadcasting, any software, patent, trade mark, design or model, plan, secret formula or process, or for information concerning industrial, commercial or scientific experience.
a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of royalties paid for the use of, or the right to use, any industrial, commercial or scientific equipment;

ppt.basis: none (Lebanon not an MLI signatory; CZ does not list this treaty)

notes: Art. 29(a): WHT on income derived on or after 1 January of the year following EIF (2000-01-24) -> 2001-01-01. Royalties: two category-specific caps without holding thresholds - 5% for equipment leasing (Art. 12(2)(a)) and 10% for copyright/software/patents/know-how etc. (Art. 12(2)(b)); the 10% entry is the general tier. Interest: residence-only. Signature date read from handwritten entry on the signature page ('Prague ... August 28 ... 1997'). Done in Arabic, Czech and English; English prevails.
unverified: Signature day '28' is handwritten on the scanned copy; treaty map had signed=null.
